##### Project general facts

Oceano is a groundbreaking residential development by The Luxe Developers, complete with its own private beach. This project is no mere residential development but rather a towering symbol of absolute refinement. With its seamless contours and absence of corners, the structure embodies the essence of defining forms and pushing ever further, featuring two towering columns connected by a floating bridge spanning levels, with an infinity pool at the summit. Oceano is where utmost sophistication and undeniable luxury collide.

Residents enjoy a carefully considered suite of amenities designed to leave an indelible mark. The development features a residential spa with soaring ceilings and calm accents for revitalisation, a stunning infinity pool nestled between architectural marvels, and over a thousand square meters of private foreshore for seclusion. Unique spaces include a Reader's Vault for enlightenment, a Cuban Cove for rich contemplation, a Chauffer's Lounge for respite, a Powerhouse fitness studio with cutting-edge equipment, and Penguin's Town for children's wellness and development. Every square inch exists to occupy a unique space of refinement.

Oceano is a work of unparalleled craftsmanship where each floor glides with rounded curves to frame the panorama. Residences enjoy a terrace that ushers the outdoors inward, combining breathtaking vistas with exquisite finishes. The configurations include one, two, three, and four-bedroom schemes, penthouse duplexes, and sky villas with private elevators, outdoor terraces, and unparalleled viewpoints. Every residence is designed for those who value true simplicity and refined living, offering ample space and flexibility in a setting where exceptional lies inside.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Marjan Island, this exceptional location offers a haven in its own right, promising an idyllic island getaway with world-class infrastructure. The island boasts a striking waterfront promenade and luxurious hotels and resorts that offer a uniquely indulgent stay, creating a vibrant and prestigious community.

The location is distinguished by its pristine coastal setting and strategic connectivity. Al Marjan Island is one of the region's most prominent tourist destinations, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. The island offers breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf, with crystal-clear waters and pristine white sandy beaches providing an ideal setting for water enthusiasts and those seeking tranquility.

For those seeking a residence that embodies absolute refinement, coastal elegance, and a prime Ras Al Khaimah address, Al Marjan Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can experience the exceptional at every glance.
